summary_zh: 這是一個由火山噴發物，形成的奇怪岩石地質公園，裡面很大，團體最好一起行動，因為裡面的指示並不是很清楚，且四處長的景像都很像，如果不是團體行動，走失的朋友可能不容易找到出口。
summary_en: This is a volcanic rock formation park created by volcanic eruptions, featuring strange and extensive geology. It is best visited with a group, as the signage inside is unclear and many sights look similar, making it easy to get lost if you are alone. Parking is available on-site (paid), and restrooms are also available (paid). Recommended stay is about 60 minutes. Travelers should stay together and be prepared for limited directional guidance.
